name: Marketing
description: Demand, pricing, positioning, research and the selling that follows from them. ⚠⚠ A large, bachelor's-dominated Florida programme: 21 public institutions awarding 2,688 credentials, 2,302 of them bachelor's. ⚠⚠⚠ And it carries the clearest example on this site of Florida's sector numbering split — Principles of Marketing exists as MAR2011 at 24 state colleges and MAR3023 at 19 mostly-university carriers, and a 2000-level course cannot supply upper-division hours toward a baccalaureate.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ READ THIS BEFORE TAKING PRINCIPLES OF MARKETING AT A STATE COLLEGE. Florida numbers the same course twice. MAR2011 is carried by 24 institutions and EVERY ONE is a Florida College System institution; MAR3023 is carried by 19, of which 11 are universities and 8 are the state colleges that hold baccalaureate authority. ⚠⚠ A 2000-level course cannot supply upper-division hours toward a Florida baccalaureate, so a student who takes MAR2011 and transfers into a marketing BBA may be asked to take the same subject again at the 3000 level. ⚠ The eight state colleges carrying BOTH numbers are the proof that this is a deliberate A.S.-to-baccalaureate ladder rather than an error — but it costs a transferring student either way. Get a written answer from the receiving department before you enrol. ⚠⚠ THE DEGREE IS A BACHELOR'S FIELD AND THE MASTER'S IS NOT WHAT PROMOTES YOU. Of 2,688 credentials, 2,302 are bachelor's and only 162 master's. That matches the occupational data: 80% of employers report a bachelor's as the entry requirement for marketing MANAGERS and only 6% a master's — while market research analysts, a more junior and more analytical role, report 30% master's. ⚠ If you want the master's, want it for the analytical specialism, not for the promotion. ⚠ Largest producers: Florida State 574, FIU 507, USF 417, FAU 273, UCF 257, UF 209.

cips.note: Marketing/Marketing Management — 21 Florida public institutions and 2,688 credentials in 2023: 2,302 bachelor's, 162 master's, 145 certificates of twelve weeks to a year, 54 associate, 25 one-to-two-year certificates. Florida State 574, FIU 507, USF 417, FAU 273, UCF 257, UF 209.
Apparel and Accessories Marketing Operations — a single Florida public carrier, Miami Dade College, awarding 34 short certificates. Claimed so that institution is listed under the programme.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The parent field and the commonest substitute — Census microdata puts BUSINESS first among the undergraduate fields held by marketing managers, at 175,070 people. ⚠ A general business degree with marketing coursework competes perfectly well for the same jobs, and is taught at more Florida institutions.

⚠ Not a route, and named only to prevent a confusion the slug invites: this is speech-language pathology, a clinical field. The COMMUNICATIONS degree that feeds marketing at 88,800 people is a different subject entirely, taught in colleges of communication and journalism.

⚠⚠ Where marketing has actually gone. Market research analysts and marketing specialists number 941,700 with 87,200 annual openings, and the work is increasingly measurement, segmentation and attribution. ⚠ MAR4613 Marketing Research and Information Systems is carried by 13 Florida institutions, and a quantitative background is the clearest way to stand out in a 2,302-bachelor's-a-year field.

⚠ Named for the sales and management side: pricing, margin and budget responsibility are what separate a marketing manager from a marketing specialist, and the $166,790 median attaches to the job that owns the numbers.
